definitions.explanation: A brown color tinged with yellow. A descriptive color term common in writing about nature, materials, and chemistry.

examples.japanese: {黄褐色|おうかっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧になって⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄褐色|おうかっしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: As autumn came, the leaves turned yellowish brown.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄褐色|おうかっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{枯|か}れ{草|くさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たない→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: This bird has a tawny back, so it doesn't stand out among dry grass.

notes:
A compound color term, literally 'yellow-brown', used for tawny or tan shades. Frequent in scientific, naturalist, and descriptive writing rather than casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄褐色|おうかっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧: a yellowish-brown liquid
- {黄褐色|おうかっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びる→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧: to take on a yellowish-brown tinge

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{褐色|かっしょく}→褐色：14115_kasshoku⟧: brown; dark brown
- {茶褐色|ちゃかっしょく}: brownish; reddish brown
